sentences.text: The longest feathers on its foot measured about 55 mm, which is slightly shorter than the length of the metatarsus itself.
The genus was first described by Xu and Zhang in the year 2005.
Xu and Zhang suggested in 2005 that the foot feathers could be ornamental or vestigial.
Recent studies have recovered Pedopenna as a scansoriopterygid, a classification within the class Reptilia.
Pedopenna is classified under the class Reptilia.

Pedopenna lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 163 million years ago in the Callovian stage, in what is now Asia, though recent radiometric dating places it at approximately 168 million years ago, with an estimated time range between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago.
Pedopenna is possibly older than Archaeopteryx, although the exact age of the Daohugou Beds where it was found is debated.
